page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head centred at top ("DE VSV" over "VI SI") with page number 146 at top left. Body text in one column, with a catchword "Quan" at lower right.

main_text.p: Se vob. Vi si raccománda, Raccomándauisi, se vobis commendat.
Sibi vos, Vi si elésse, Elésseuisi, Dío per figli-uóli, Deus sibi vos elegit filios.
Illic, vel illuc se, Visi vccíse, Vccíseuisi, se illic interemit. Vi si lascið, lasciðuisi condúrre: se illuc ducere permisit.
Illic sibi, Vi si comprò, Coprðuuisi úna vigna, sibi illic vineam emit.
main_text.head: VI CI
main_text.p: Vos nob. vel Nos vob. Dío vi ci diéde, Diédeuici per compágni, Deus vos nob. vel nos vobis socios dedit.
Vos illic, Vi ci battérono, Battéronuici, vos illic verberarunt.
Vos illuc, Vi ci menárono, Menáronuici, Vos illuc duxerunt.
Vob. illic, Via compráste, Comprásteuici úna cása, Domum vob. illic emistis.

Quando autē hæ particulæ coniūgun-tur cum particula, ne, amitunt, I, & recipiunt, E, hoc modo: me ne, te ne, se ne, ce ne, ve ne, vel, sequente tamen vocali, Men', Ten', Sen', Cen', Ven', cū apostrop.

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic and roman mixed; some words are doubtful (e.g. "Vi ci battérono", "Coprðuuisi"). The catchword "Quan" appears at the foot right and is also the start of the next page's word. Marginal fragments of show-through from the reverse side were ignored.
